title: Target’s Approach to Disaster Preparedness, Response and Recovery
summary: Learn how Target supports local communities before and after disaster strikes.
body_markdown:
Q:


How does Target support long term recovery efforts?


A:


Since 2024, we have donated more than $5.7 million in one-time donations to support long-term recovery efforts for communities impacted by natural disasters. This includes a $3 million commitment in 2024 to support recovery efforts in areas affected by Hurricane Helene, helping non-profit programs like Strongward’s Disaster Assistance program.


Q:


What disaster relief organizations does Target partner with?


A:


We partner with a number of domestic and global partner organizations to support our teams and communities.


Domestic partner organizations:


- [American Red Cross](https://www.redcross.org/)
- [Team Rubicon](https://teamrubiconusa.org/)
- [Strongward](https://www.sbpusa.org/disaster-assistance-program/)
- [Footprint Project](https://www.footprintproject.org/)
- [Feeding America and food bank affiliates](https://www.feedingamerica.org/)


Global Partner Organizations:


- [UNICEF](https://www.unicef.org/)
- [World Food Program USA](https://donate.wfpusa.org/page/Funding_SRCH_UNR?sfcid=701Rc00000b7WsJIAU&ms=Modal-Campaign_SRCH_GSA_Brand_Brand_Brand-AD-Campaign_AD_UNR&utm_source=google_search&utm_medium=paid_search&utm_campaign=Modal-Campaign&utm_content=Brand-AD-Campaign&gad_source=1&gad_campaignid=18627349122&gbraid=0AAAAADhCE4T_j3t-ufQj7v-CaeKFSOfhQ)
- [International Medical Corps](https://internationalmedicalcorps.org/)


Q:


I have a question about how Target’s providing relief support for a recent event. How can I contact Target?


A:


Visit the[Contact & Help page](https://corporate.target.com/about/contact-help) for details on contacting our Media Relations department.
